assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a reusable transparent sprite for the 2.5D tactics game Ooze Tactics. Reference image 1 is the owner-approved visual direction: teal living tissue, amber internal organs, thick membranes, stepped pixel-art contours, and a continuous colony. Preserve that style and its rich organic shading; do not redesign into a cute mascot. Use a fixed three-quarter overhead orthographic view, facing lower-right, consistent upper-left lighting. One isolated functional organ with only a very small low contact-root flange at its base so it can blend into a separate continuous territory surface. No stone pedestal, tile square, floor, background, cast glow, text, border, other roles, sheet, or UI. The asset must have genuinely transparent space around its entire silhouette, with at least 15 percent padding. Teal outer tissue is the recolorable faction channel; amber innards remain a contrasting secondary material. No faces, eyes, armor, or equipment. Keep the design legible at approximately 96 screen pixels tall. The base contact point is centered near the lower fifth of the image. ROLE: HEART / CORE. The protected heart organ from the reference, as a compact upright amber chamber supported by three thick teal membrane folds rooted into living flesh. Strong central silhouette, visible pulsing nucleus; no extended surrounding colony or long tendrils. Match the heart in the reference rather than inventing a new identity.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: repeating surface texture for connected BASIC ooze territory in Ooze Tactics. Reference image is the approved tissue style; create only its low flat teal connecting flesh, no organs. Square, flat orthographic overhead material swatch filling the complete canvas edge to edge, seamless repeating boundaries. Dense but quiet deep teal membrane with broad shallow folds, a few muted mint rim highlights and sparse thin organic veins. Deliberate stepped pixel-art shading matching the reference, limited palette, consistent broad value range. Keep contrast subdued so role sprites remain the focal point. No visible tiles, grid, edges, outer rim, tendrils, nucleus, amber vesicles, organs, ground, text, labels, vignette, gradients, bloom or transparency. All four boundaries should tile; this is a material sampled under a separate animated colony silhouette, not a finished territory tile or a creature.
